_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic panel, razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line, pristine architectural perspective, crisp silhouettes, clean expressive character geometry, generous negative space. an environment sheet of a Pacific Northwest estuary at low tide from a bluff: long bands of mudflat, a channel reflecting the sky, old cannery pilings, log booms, a heron, a far wall of spruce, the bay mouth opening to the ocean; insets at dawn, dusk and under a bruised indigo storm sky; labeled ALSEA BAY. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, airbrush, neon, anime, watermark, extra fingers
